subject: Handoff & kickoff planning — Helio AI (post-signing)
messages:
From: Dev Patel <dev_patel@redwood.com>
To: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>
Cc: Caitlin Brooks <caitlin@helio.ai>, Procurement <procurement@helio.ai>
Date: Sun, 27 Jun 2027 10:12:00 -0700
Subject: Handoff: Helio AI — Post-signing activation & initial targets

Hi team,

Quick handoff — Helio signed yesterday (DocuSign attached). Summary and asks below so CS and infra can pick up the run: 

Deal snapshot:
- ARR: $420k first year (tiered usage)
- Committed dedicated capacity: 2 x A100-equivalent GPUs (reserved) + burst pool
- Go-live target: 2027-07-22 (customer-facing pilot)
- Primary contact: Caitlin Brooks (CPO) — caitlin@helio.ai

Customer goals:
- Latency: sub-250ms p50 for short chat flows (<= 256 tokens)
- Throughput: 80 concurrent users during pilot window
- Data retention/segregation: logs stored 30 days, no PII retention beyond session scope

Technical notes (from last technical call):
- They will use the Redwood API (chat + embeddings) with moderate-length contexts; expect many short requests
- They want model variant r-instruct-70B-8q as the baseline; we recommended a quantized variant for cost
- They requested SOC2 evidence and penetration-test summary (I attached SOC2 link in thread)

Open commercial/procurement items:
- Procurement confirmed PO will be issued by 2027-07-05
- Billing contact: procurement@helio.ai

Attachments: Helio_SOW_v2.pdf, Mutual_Action_Plan.xlsx (contains milestone dates and responsibilities)

Requested CS/Infra actions:
1) Assign CS owner and schedule a 60-minute kickoff with Helio and technical stakeholders (propose July 8–10 window)
2) Confirm infra capacity reservation and pre-provision GPU pool by July 12
3) Share the onboarding runbook with Helio and request workspace access details (API keys, internal test accounts)
4) Upload SOC2 evidence to the shared drive link below

Marissa, can you own the customer success intake? Vivek — can you confirm the reserved-capacity provisioning ETA and any limits we should flag?

Thanks — I’ll monitor procurement and update the HubSpot deal.

— Dev
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
From: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.com>
To: Dev Patel <dev_patel@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>
Cc: Caitlin Brooks <caitlin@helio.ai>, Procurement <procurement@helio.ai>
Date: Sun, 27 Jun 2027 11:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Handoff: Helio AI — Post-signing activation & initial targets

Thanks Dev — great summary. Welcome, Caitlin and team.

Marissa — I’m assigning the CS intake to you as owner for this account. Please take the lead on kickoff scheduling and the mutual action plan from the attached XLS. Action items for immediate follow-up: 
- Owner assignment: Marissa Cole (CS Lead) — please confirm and add your point-of-contact.
- Kickoff window: propose Thu 2027-07-08 10:00–11:00 PT for an initial kickoff (Marissa, if that works please calendar and include dev + infra).
- Pre-kick checklist: API keys, SSO/SCIM decision, test data access, and a short list of success scenarios (we need to confirm pilot flows).

Caitlin — can you confirm whether the procurement PO will be completed by 7/5 and whether you have SSO vendor info we should add to the runbook? If SOC2 evidence is needed earlier, we can upload to the shared Drive immediately.

Vivek — please confirm capacity provisioning timeline and whether we need a temporary performance test window before pilot. If there are any constraints on the r-instruct-70B-8q variant we should flag them here.

I will remain on the thread for escalation and to help unblock resource approvals.

— Stephanie
VP, Customer Success Operations | Redwood Inference
From: Caitlin Brooks <caitlin@helio.ai>
To: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Dev Patel <dev_patel@redwood.com>

Subject: Re: Handoff: Helio AI — Post-signing activation & initial targets

Thanks all — excited to get started. Quick answers: 
- PO: procurement expects to issue PO by 2027-07-02 (they said 7/5 earlier but we pushed; should be sooner)
- Kickoff: July 8 at 10am PT works for our team. Please send calendar invite.
- SSO: we use Okta and will share the SCIM app details in a follow-up note (I can loop in our IT lead if you want).
- SOC2: happy to receive a link to your report; our security team will review and may follow up with a short questionnaire.

We completed the DocuSign for the SOW this morning. I’ve cc’d procurement for any billing notes.

— Caitlin
CPO | Helio AI

Thanks — I’ll take the intake. 

Next steps from CS side (I’ll action these and loop in owners):
- Send kickoff invite for Thu 2027-07-08 10:00–11:00 PT (calendar invite going out within 30m).
- Pre-kick questionnaire to Caitlin/IT (API usage patterns, expected daily active users, SSO admin contact).
- Share onboarding runbook and a short pilot success criteria doc (I attached a link to the runbook in the Drive; attachment stub included).

Internal note: we should capture two success metrics for the pilot — (1) API latency under 250ms p50 for 80% of calls, and (2) baseline embedding accuracy on our sample dataset (Marissa will run initial eval).

Subject: Re: Handoff: Helio AI — Post-signing activation & initial targets

Looping in infra updates and a couple of internal constraints: 
- Capacity reservation: the 2 x A100-equivalent pool is provisioned in us-west-2 and will be available for smoke tests on 2027-07-11. Full network ACLs and VPC peering require Helio IP ranges (Caitlin, please share).
- Model variant: the r-instruct-70B-8q quantized build needs a short warm-up run; we recommend a 24-hour warm-up and a 2-hour load test before pilot.
- Latency note: 250ms p50 is achievable for short chat as long as we keep sequence lengths <= 256 and enable prefix KV caching. If they push longer contexts we should expect p50 to move up.

Internal operational asks: 
- Marissa: please request a performance window on 2027-07-13 for a 2-hour load test (80 concurrent simulated users) and confirm a point-of-contact to grant test keys.
- Dev: I left an internal comment on the HubSpot deal with the infra ticket number: INFRA-8742. Please reference that for escalation.

Attachment: perf_test_playbook.pdf (stub)

— Vivek
Director, Platform Services | Redwood Inference
